newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Cyrix shrs fall.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Cyrix shrs fall.

text.p: Shares of Cyrix Corp slipped after hours on Monday, following news that the company's president and chief executive, Jerry Rogers, would resign.
The company's stock fell 7/8 to 21-1/2. During market hours, Cyrix gained one to unofficially close at 22-3/8.
The computer processor company did not elaborate on the reason for his departure but said it has hired a search firm to replace Rogers.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 1,400 shares compared to 10,500 shares on Friday. There was no session two volume compared to 3,998,200 shares on Friday, the NYSE said.
